name: Isometric
after: isometric infrastructure drawings (FossFLOW, vendor 3D icon sets)
blurb: The whole model tipped into isometric: zones become raised plates, boxes become blocks with their logo standing on top, lines run along the ground.
good: Overview slides, posters and onboarding: where things run, at a glance. Not for detailed data flows; use a flat style for those.
source: the isometric look of FossFLOW (MIT) and cloud vendors' 3D diagrams, drawn by our renderer; no icons or art copied.
rules: Zones are raised plates, nested zones sit a step higher
Every box is a block of the same height; the logo stands on top
Lines run on the ground, labels stand upright
Keep it under about 15 boxes, or it turns into a city
